source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Monoecious tree to 40 m or more
morphology_documented.stems: Small branches often with corky ridges; often exudes gum
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate, simple, deciduous; blade to ca. 18 cm long and 12 cm wide; deeply palmately 5–7-lobed, acuminate lobes usually serrate; crushed leaves fragrant; petioles to 12 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Unisexual, apetalous; staminate flowers in bracteate globose masses on racemes to 6 cm; pistillate flowers in peduncled globose heads
morphology_documented.fruit: Woody globose clusters to 3 cm diameter of 2-beaked capsules
morphology_documented.habitat: Wet areas, low or rich woods

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical flora places genus with Hamamelidaceae/Altingioideae; current repo uses Altingiaceae
Flora says mainly eastern Texas and cultivated farther west; this is not county-level BONAP evidence
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
